title: degit.json
description: Post-clone actions for degit, specified in a degit.json file at the top level of the working directory. See https://github.com/Rich-Harris/degit#actions.

clone.title: clone
clone.description: Clone another repository into the working directory, preserving its existing contents.

src.description: The repository to clone, in the same format accepted by the degit CLI (e.g. user/repo).

cache.description: Use a cached version of the repository if available.

files.description: Only keep these files or directories from the cloned repository.

verbose.description: Show extra information about the clone.

searchReplace.title: search_replace
searchReplace.description: Replace every match of a regular expression in the listed files.

pattern.description: A regular expression (as a string) to match within each file.

replacement.description: The name of an environment variable whose value replaces each match.

remove.title: remove
remove.description: Remove one or more files from the working directory.

allowGlobs.description: When true, entries in files may contain glob patterns such as ** or *.md. Glob patterns are disabled by default because they can match more files than intended.

files.description: A single path or an array of paths, resolved relative to the destination. Paths outside the destination are skipped.
